name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: I've spent the last eight years managing an ongoing medical condition, and part of that has been fighting insurers for approval on imaging, including MRIs. I know how confusing and expensive that process is for the person going through it. A company that makes imaging simpler and fairly priced is one I'd be proud to market, and member communications that are clear and on time are a big part of how that promise reaches people.

Execution is where I'm strongest. I've built and deployed 20+ automated lifecycle workflows in GoHighLevel and HubSpot, including email and SMS journeys for onboarding, reminders, and reactivation, and I've worked hands-on in Marketo and Mailchimp. I build landing pages and forms, write the copy, run A/B tests, and report on what worked. I run projects in Asana, Jira, and ClickUp, and I coordinated 25+ client launches a month at Wix against a set launch process. I also build AI-assisted workflows and check their output before anything goes out, which fits how your team already works. I haven't used Braze or managed print and direct-mail vendors yet; the journey building, QA, and coordination carry over, and I'd get up to speed quickly.
I'd welcome a conversation about the member marketing team. I'm available at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
